i.norm: Verifies that assigning a plain (non-JTS) ShapeFactoryImpl to a JtsSpatialContextFactory and then calling newSpatialContext() throws a RuntimeException. JtsSpatialContextFactory expects a JTS-aware ShapeFactory whose constructor accepts (SpatialContext, SpatialContextFactory). ShapeFactoryImpl lacks such a constructor, so reflective instantiation inside SpatialContextFactory fails and is wrapped in a RuntimeException.
Arrange: create a JTS factory and override shapeFactoryClass with a non-JTS implementation
Act & Assert: building the context must fail because ShapeFactoryImpl is incompatible with JtsSpatialContextFactory (it does not satisfy the required JTS constructor contract)
The exception is expected to originate from SpatialContextFactory's reflective class-instantiation logic
